findings.text: QUEUED_POINTER_DUTY_KINDS omits run-stalled, a row derived only while the pointer reads queued (reckon/crew/obligations.py:1308-1310), so a stalled request launched during a held tick keeps a stale row offering to reprioritise or drop a run that is already working.

A pointer that parses as an object with no phase resolves to the empty string at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1086 and settles the queued duty, although a phase-less pointer is no more evidence that the run moved than an unparseable one, which the sentinel keeps.

The done_when required both suite arms on all_debug; the manifest names a /tmp scratch tree on the fleet node and no sbatch or srun appears in any run log, so the arms ran in place although they are seconds long.

SCORE durability: 17
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_launched_run_owes_no_queued_duty.py:157 re-serves the held snapshot after the pointer moves and drives the stop hook in a subprocess, so reverting the phase comparison reddens it; the unreadable-pointer branch at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1082 and the run-queued and queued-contract-refused kinds have no test.

SCORE reuse: 14
JUSTIFICATION reuse: I searched reckon/crew for a pointer-phase reader and found runs.read_pointer (raises on both absent and malformed), run_paths._read_json_file (None for both) and recovery_classification._review_pointer_phase:666 (two-state, private); none carries the absent-vs-unreadable distinction this needs or is importable under the module banner, so _live_pointer_phase is a near-copy of the last, and a shared tolerant reader in runs.py would have served all three.
FINDING reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1058 non-blocking: QUEUED_POINTER_DUTY_KINDS omits run-stalled, a row derived only while the pointer reads queued (reckon/crew/obligations.py:1308-1310), so a stalled request launched during a held tick keeps a stale row offering to reprioritise or drop a run that is already working; the deliverable's 'never list a duty for a run whose pointer has since left the phase' therefore holds for three of the four queued-phase kinds.
FINDING reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1086 non-blocking: a pointer that parses as an object with no phase resolves to the empty string and settles the queued duty, although a pointer carrying no phase is no more evidence that the run moved than an unparseable one, which the sentinel deliberately keeps.
